mcp-ext.server.enabled.description: Start the HTTP server when StarUML starts. Takes effect after a restart.

mcp-ext.server.port.description: Loopback port the HTTP server listens on. Takes effect after a restart.

mcp-ext.limits.maxBodyKiB.description: Largest request body accepted, in KiB; larger requests get 413. Applies to the next request.

mcp-ext.limits.maxBatchOps.description: Most ops one /batch request may carry; more get 413. Applies to the next request.
